_doc: App-only settings layered over algorithm.default.json (copied unchanged from learnspace-sim v1.0). Keys starting with '_' are documentation. Only keys listed here differ from the simulation.

bandit._ts_mode: The app must log propensities, so it uses Monte Carlo probsTS (LEARNSPACE_RESEARCH_UPDATE.md section 3).

app._sessions: Number of planned sessions S for the curriculum base. Open decision (section 12.2); must be set before sessions start.
app._correct_min_score: A graded answer counts as correct at score >= this value on the grader's 0-3 scale.
